summary: Submitted draft/submission.json (action=review) for the accepted direct check 9f34a5234198450294cba15c91ace5b8 (version 1) of obligation c-single-vote-per-term. It supplies the whole-artifact contract the controller requested — the required checker_correspondence item plus the applicability item — and resolves both open input issues on this artifact's lineage (fe298a8a184a4b04b3a4398b05f3009e on the claim and 319d036ca1974b0ea1ab449ef0baefcc on the fixed plan), each with a retained condition disposition of independent scope. The correspondence item (no_issue_found, 11 cited ranges, 5 retained limitations) states that the checked proposition is the escalation the first confirmed defect recorded as unknown rather than a restatement of it, and reviews the fixed inputs, binding, oracle, correlation, legality and counterevidence together: nodes are built by the package's own NewRaft over the real NetworkTransport with a socket-free StreamLayer; exactly one StableStore CurrentTerm write is held inside SetUint64; the stale heartbeat carries term 6 while the published term is still 1, so it is handled normally; the higher-term vote for term 7 is granted because the record is still empty; after the release the same heartbeat would be rejected on every later read, and the node's own election derives published+1; the binding bind-raft-elect-self locates the second writer of the record; the oracle is the invariant itself with applicability requiring the candidates to differ, so a legitimate same-candidate re-grant is never judged; the admission prerequisite precedes the result in the single runner stream with matching identity and a later complete result, and the record pair is double-read before acceptance. The retained observation is the violation: first vote term 7 for d1-pipe granted with term_after_release 6, state Follower and term_write sequence 0,1,1,6,7,7, then second vote term 7 for f1-pipe with same_candidate false and state Candidate, at exit 0. Counterevidence is recorded rather than suppressed: the delayed write is an injection on an injected dependency reached through the documented callback contract; the witness is the local record only, since two leaders in one term would need other voters' records corrupted as well; absent the delayed write the invariant holds because the published term is monotonic; and the reading that only the grant path owes the rule is kept as an alternative. The applicability item (no_issue_found, 9 cited ranges, 3 limitations) argues why the implementation owes the rule in this scope — the durable record is the vote the grant path reads and that a restarted node consults, and the candidate path writes that same record for its proposed term without comparing it — and answers the two-writer asymmetry as an outstanding-repair boundary and possible repair locations rather than as a discharge. With both blockers answered, the assessment for this artifact should recompute to a confirmed violated comparison at implementation_obligation level, completing the obligation and turning its conclusion into a confirmed in-scope result. Optional preflight with the trusted validator returned valid=true; the review introduces no new execution and no map change, and the Chinese fields are presentation only.
